The user wants to run a bash command and copy its output. We need to run the command exactly as given, using bash tool.

We must use the bash tool with command: echo $0; echo $SHELL; uname -s; command -v node git; echo hors > ../hors-worktree.txt; echo fait

Need to run in the repository. We can call bash tool. Use workdir default. For Windows environment but bash tool is used. Since we are inside repository C:\Users\user\AppData\Local\Temp\esc25\wt-agent1. Running the command will create file ../hors-worktree.txt relative to current. That would go one level up from this dir: ../ corresponds to C:\Users\user\AppData\Local\Temp\esc25 maybe. That file will be created. The user requests "recopie sa sortie" so must output the printed lines. Let's run.
